links.outcome: AI literacy, attitudes, and acceptance before vs after short AI training
links.effect: Attitudes and acceptance improved significantly (p<0.01); AI literacy scores improved but not statistically significantly.
links.quote: The training enhanced students’ engagement with AI; however, the development of deep AI literacy was found to require repeated and practice-based learning experiences.
